text:
deploybot: Pin operation started for runtime-3.2 -> runtime-3.2 (model group: llama3q-quant). request_id=rb-1799990000 status=IN_PROGRESS :gear:

maria.g: seeing a steady stream of allocation failures in eu-west, pin stuck at 42% and new canary instances keep cycling :eyes:

aj: confirmed — KV cache warmups failing on longseq, lots of OOM-ish traces in the logs. can we abort?

deploybot: abort not allowed while drain-phase=on. Manual cancel available but will drop in-flight requests. use: `/deploybot pin cancel rb-1799990000 --force` (warning: will cause errors).

eli.sre: telemetry shows KV cache miss rate x3 and per-token latency up ~230ms after the pin. suspected kernel/kvcache mismatch between runtime-3.2 and the quant model path. vote: route back to runtime-3.1 for affected model group, avoid full cancel for now.

kate.pm: need to minimize customer-visible errors. routing fallback + short rollback window sounds safest. also will prep a short release note / support blurb if we roll back.

maria.g: proposed plan: 1) apply temporary routing rule to steer llama3q -> runtime-3.1 for 60 minutes, 2) monitor errors/latency, 3) if stable, schedule controlled rollback of the pin with a ticketed rollback window and postmortem. @aj can you apply the route?

aj: on it. applying fallback now:

```
/routes apply --scope model:llama3q-quant --from runtime-3.2 --to runtime-3.1 --duration 3600 --reason "kvcache regressions after runtime-3.2 pin" --force
```

aj: route applied, 12,138 requests rerouted, change_id=rout-1799990001 :white_check_mark:

deploybot: routing rule active. continuing pin drain in parallel but traffic now routed away from affected pool.

sre-bot: Alert: error-rate for llama3q decreased from 8.2% -> 1.3% within 2m of reroute. latency median dropped ~180ms. :thumbsup:

eli.sre: good signal. keep an eye on memory churn on runtime-3.1 nodes — we might see transient pressure from extra traffic.

maria.g: agreed. @aj can you hold on forced cancel unless errors spike back up above 5%? we'll give ops 1 hour to collect traces and decide rollback vs shim patch.

aj: holding. collecting logs and core dumps to a ticket: https://redwood.local/ops/ticket/179999-rlg (internal).

kate.pm: I'll draft customer-facing note: short blurb + expected timeline. tagging support for watch shift.

maria.g: follow-ups: update pinlist to include a compat-flag for models using kvcache-hotpaths, add a pre-pin smoke that runs longseq warmups, and schedule a micro-postmortem after the window. filing PRs after this thread.

aj: ack. will also add a temporary canary annotation so deploybot will exclude llama3q from next auto-pin wave until we triage.

deploybot: annotation added: exclude:model=llama3q-quant until tag cleared.

maria.g: thanks all. marking thread resolved for now, will reopen if error-rate rises. :heart:

kate.pm: thanks team — will post final notes when we decide next steps.

sre-bot: Note: scheduled job `pin-compat-smoke` created to run longseq warmup in staging (cron in 5m).
